plans.name: Group Health Insurance (HMO)
plans.description: Comprehensive in-patient and out-patient medical cover through a licensed HMO, extending to immediate family.
plans.coverageDetails: Employee + spouse + up to 4 children · in-patient, out-patient, dental and optical care

plans.name: Contributory Pension Scheme
plans.description: Retirement savings account with a licensed Pension Fund Administrator, per the Pension Reform Act.

plans.name: Group Life Assurance
plans.description: Statutory life cover paying out at least three times annual gross salary to a nominated beneficiary.

plans.name: Group Personal Accident Cover
plans.description: Covers accidental death, and permanent or temporary disability, arising in the course of employment.

plans.name: Annual Leave
plans.description: Paid time off every year, pro-rated by employment type and increasing with tenure.
plans.coverageDetails: 21–30 working days/year depending on grade and tenure

plans.name: Leave Allowance
plans.description: One-off cash allowance paid alongside annual leave, standard practice across Nigerian employers.
plans.coverageDetails: 10% of annual basic salary, paid once per year

plans.name: 13th Month Bonus
plans.description: Not a statutory requirement, but near-universal across corporate Nigeria — one month's basic salary paid every December.
plans.coverageDetails: One month's basic salary, pro-rated for partial years

plans.name: Paid Parental Leave
plans.description: Fully paid time off around the birth or adoption of a child.
plans.coverageDetails: 16 weeks maternity · 4 weeks paternity, at full pay

plans.name: Transport & Housing Allowance
plans.description: Monthly allowance paid alongside salary to offset commuting and housing costs.

plans.name: Meal Subsidy
plans.description: Subsidised meals on-site, or a daily meal allowance for remote and field-based staff.

plans.name: Remote Work & Data Stipend
plans.description: Monthly stipend toward internet/data and home-office costs for staff who work outside a fixed office.

plans.name: Employee Assistance Program
plans.description: Confidential counselling, mental health support and a wellness helpline, open to every employee and their immediate family.

plans.name: Wellness & Gym Membership Subsidy
plans.description: Partial reimbursement of gym or fitness membership fees.

plans.name: Learning & Development Budget
plans.description: Annual budget toward courses, certifications and conferences, plus access to internal training programmes.

plans.name: Long Service Award
plans.description: One-off cash award and recognition at 5, 10 and 15-year work anniversaries.
